label: preparing
what: A coordinated catered gathering, probably in the great hall and plausibly a celebration of my forty years as mayor. Builder donated hall lighting and needs a substantial bread order; baker, freight and innkeeper are coordinating provisions and seeking grain, purchases or barter. The gathering's purpose has not been disclosed to me, so the anniversary connection remains an inference. Secretary is knowingly helping obtain provisioning details, though she may not know any concealed celebratory purpose. Neighbour's ordinary tea invitation alone does not establish involvement.
